paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from 11.1 x g_KSVZ using KSVZ relation)
notes: Double-cell cavity haloscope (CAPP-9T). Excludes g_agamma >= 11.1 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over m_a = 13.0-13.9 ueV. Paper reports limit only relative to KSVZ; I converted the endpoints using g_KSVZ = 0.97*alpha/(pi*f_a) with m_a = 5.70 ueV*(1e12 GeV/f_a), giving ~5.7e-14 to 6.1e-14 GeV^-1. Actual exclusion line varies bin-by-bin with mode-mixing gaps near 13.35 ueV; only two representative endpoints given. rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
